title: 《遗忘之海》好金砖速刷攻略：零氪首周怎么赚、该卖什么、什么时候别乱买
titleEn: Sea of Remnants Good Gold Bricks Farming Guide: What to Sell, What to Hold, and When Not to Buy
summary: 围绕《遗忘之海》贸易场最关键的流通货币「好金砖」，讲清零氪首周的获取路线、优先出售的物品、什么时候该囤、什么时候别冲动消费。
summaryEn: A practical guide to Good Gold Bricks in Sea of Remnants: first-week farming routes, what to sell first, what to hold, and when to avoid impulse buys.
content:
## 先说结论

如果你是零氪或月卡玩家，**首周最重要的经济目标不是立刻买最贵的外观，而是先建立稳定的好金砖现金流**。原因很简单：

- 公测首周价格波动最大，冲动消费最容易买在高点。
- 你越早理解什么该卖、什么该囤，后面越容易靠交易系统滚起资源。
- 《遗忘之海》和普通二游最大的差异，恰恰就在这个可交易生态里。

## 好金砖是什么

好金砖是《遗忘之海》贸易场里的核心流通货币。你主要通过两种方式获得：

1. **自己出海探索拿掉落，再卖给其他玩家**
2. **低价买、高价卖，吃供需波动**

官方在 2026 年 6 月 25 日前瞻里已经明确把贸易场当成公测主卖点之一，所以这不是边缘玩法，而是首周就该学会的主系统。

## 首周最稳的赚钱路线

### 第 1 阶段：先别买，先卖

开服前 2 到 3 天，优先做这件事：

- 把你暂时用不到的高热度外观材料、稀有掉落、可交易资源先挂出去。
- 原因不是它们以后一定会跌，而是**首周抢跑期的“刚需溢价”最高**。
- 尤其是跟首发热门角色、热门外观、直播宣传热点绑定的物品，前几天通常最容易溢价成交。

### 第 2 阶段：只补你主队真正缺的东西

有了第一笔好金砖后，不要立刻去买“看起来很值”的收藏。优先级建议是：

1. 主队推进确实卡住的资源
2. 能明显提高首周效率的功能型物品
3. 热门但你本周根本用不到的外观，先不碰

### 第 3 阶段：等价格回落再补收藏

很多新服都会出现同一种情况：

- 首周大家都想买热门外观和装饰
- 第二周开始，一部分玩家开始出货回笼资金
- 这时价格通常比首周情绪顶点更友好

所以如果你不是重度外观党，**首周先赚钱，第二周再消费，通常比开服当天直接冲更稳**。

## 什么东西优先卖

虽然公测实际价格会由服务器决定，但按新服常见规律，首周优先卖的通常是这三类：

### 1. 热门角色关联资源

凡是和热门船员、热门阵容、主播推荐角色强绑定的资源，都更容易被高价接走。因为开服期大量玩家会为了立刻成型而加价购买。

### 2. 早期稀有掉落

早期能稳定产出的玩家少，供给还没起来，这种物品最容易出现短期高价。

### 3. 外观相关材料

《遗忘之海》的风格党很多，外观和装扮消费意愿通常比传统数值手游更高。只要某件装扮在社区或直播里形成热度，相关交易物很容易被追价。

## 什么东西别急着卖

### 1. 你主队一周内马上要用的资源

别为了眼前一点好金砖，把你自己明后天推进要用的材料卖掉，否则最后还是得高价买回。

### 2. 明显会被版本热点带动的物品

如果官方刚预告联动、热门船员、或者某套外观要进热度期，相关物品未必适合立刻清仓。先看 24 小时到 48 小时社区风向，再决定。

### 3. 你根本没搞懂用途的稀有物

遇到这类物品，先查用途，再决定卖不卖。最亏的不是卖便宜，而是把后面会暴涨的东西当垃圾处理了。

## 首周最常见的 4 个亏钱动作

### 1. 第一天就把所有好金砖买成外观

这会让你第二天开始没有机动资金，遇到真正卡进度的资源只能干瞪眼。

### 2. 看见价格跌一点就恐慌甩卖

新服前几天本来就会剧烈波动。短线波动不等于趋势反转。

### 3. 把“我喜欢”和“我现在需要”混为一谈

喜欢的外观以后也能补；推进效率断了，首周节奏会整个掉下去。

### 4. 没有记账

建议最简单也要记三件事：

- 今天卖了什么
- 卖出价大概多少
- 哪些是你后面可能还会回购的

只要连续记 3 天，你对服务器价格的感觉会明显比只凭直觉强很多。

## 零氪首周的推荐经济节奏

### Day 1-2

- 主线推进优先
- 所有可交易掉落先分用途
- 不急买收藏，先建立第一笔好金砖余额

### Day 3-4

- 开始判断哪些物品是高热短炒，哪些是稳定刚需
- 只给主队补最关键的缺口
- 第一次尝试“卖一部分、留一部分”而不是一次清仓

### Day 5-7

- 看价格是否进入回落区间
- 如果现金流稳定，再开始补你真正想长期留的外观或资源
- 为第二周联动、活动、角色热度变化预留余地

## 这篇和贸易场总览怎么配合看

- 如果你还没搞懂贸易场系统本身，先看 [贸易场系统详解](/zh/sea/guides/trade-market-guide)
- 如果你在犹豫零氪到底能不能玩，接着看 [付费模式详解](/zh/sea/guides/payment-model-guide)
- 如果你现在正卡在“抽角色还是抽服装”，继续看下一篇决策页会更直接
contentEn:
## The Fast Take

If you are free-to-play or a light spender, your first-week economy goal is not buying the coolest cosmetic immediately. It is building a steady Good Gold Bricks cash flow first.

That matters because launch-week prices are the most volatile, impulse buys are the most expensive, and Sea of Remnants stands out from other games precisely because its trade economy actually changes your progression options.

## What Good Gold Bricks Are

Good Gold Bricks are the core currency inside the Sea of Remnants trade market. You mainly get them in two ways:

1. Explore, loot, and sell what other players need.
2. Buy low and sell high when supply and demand swing.

The official June 25, 2026 preview clearly positioned the market as a major launch system, so this is not a side mechanic. It is part of your first-week plan.

## The Safest First-Week Route

### Phase 1: Sell before you buy

During the first two or three days, focus on selling usable high-interest drops, cosmetic-related goods, and anything tied to launch hype before spending on expensive cosmetics.

### Phase 2: Only patch real bottlenecks

Once you have your first batch of bricks, use them on the few items that genuinely unblock your main team or your weekly pace. Do not burn the whole balance on things that only look efficient.

### Phase 3: Let the launch premium cool down

A lot of launch servers show the same pattern: hype drives the first wave of purchases, then early players start cashing out. That usually makes week-two shopping much cleaner than day-one shopping.

## What Usually Sells Best

### 1. Items tied to popular crews

Anything linked to launch-favorite units, community meta picks, or streamer hype tends to move faster and at better prices.

### 2. Early rare drops

Supply is still thin during the first few days, so rare drops can command strong short-term prices.

### 3. Cosmetic-related goods

Sea of Remnants has a style-heavy audience. Cosmetics and fashion items often pull stronger launch demand than players expect.

## What Not to Sell Too Fast

### 1. Items your core team will need tomorrow

Do not sell a short-term bottleneck just to feel richer for one night and then buy it back at a worse price later.

### 2. Items that may be pushed by new hype

If a crossover, crew, or cosmetic spotlight is about to hit, related goods may deserve another day or two of observation.

### 3. Rare items whose function you do not understand yet

The most painful mistake is not selling low. It is dumping something valuable before you even understand its role.

## The Four Most Common Launch Mistakes

1. Spending every brick on cosmetics on day one.
2. Panic-selling the first time prices dip.
3. Confusing what you like with what you need now.
4. Tracking nothing.

A simple log of what you sold, roughly for how much, and what you may need to rebuy later already gives you a better feel for your server economy.

## Suggested F2P Launch Rhythm

### Days 1-2

- Push story and unlock systems.
- Sort tradeable drops by use case.
- Build your first brick balance before shopping.

### Days 3-4

- Start splitting items into short-hype and stable-demand categories.
- Buy only the resources that truly unblock your main team.
- Try partial selling instead of all-in clearing.

### Days 5-7

- Watch for price cooldowns.
- Only start cosmetic shopping once your cash flow looks stable.
- Keep room for week-two events, crossovers, and meta shifts.

## What to Read Next

- If you still need the system overview, go to [Trade Market Guide](/en/sea/guides/trade-market-guide)
- If you want to understand the broader monetization picture, go to [Payment add-onel Guide](/en/sea/guides/payment-model-guide)
- If you are stuck on pulling characters versus cosmetics, the next decision page is the right follow-up

faq.question: Should I spend Good Gold Bricks on cosmetics during the first week?
faq.questionZh: 首周要不要直接把好金砖花在外观上？
faq.answer: Usually no. Build cash flow first, fix your real progression bottlenecks, and wait for hype pricing to cool before buying expensive cosmetics.
faq.answerZh: 通常不建议。先建立现金流、补真正卡进度的缺口，再等热度价格回落后买外观会更稳。

faq.question: What is the safest thing to do with early rare drops?
faq.questionZh: 前期稀有掉落最稳的处理方式是什么？
faq.answer: Check whether your main team needs them soon. If not, launch-week scarcity often makes them strong sell candidates.
faq.answerZh: 先看你的主队近期要不要用。如果短期用不到，开服期的稀缺性往往让它们更适合先卖掉。
